messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGE fired for prometheus.scrape_failure (service=metrics-pipeline, region=eu-west-1) — 8 distinct scrape targets failing, average scrape_error_rate 0.87 over 5m. Pager: PagerDuty (pd-oncall)
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident INC123456 triggered — urgent -> SRE on-call
jordan: Got the page, looking now. seeing a bunch of 503s from metrics-exporter in eu-west-1.
maya: Confirmed dashboards stale for customer-facing dashboards (response_time, error_rate). customers complaining about missing metrics on platform-monitor.
kevin: I can take the on-call handoff if jordan needs to dig in deeper. ping me if needed.
jordan: handing off to kevin for mitigation. I'm going to start with exporter pod checks and scrape logs.
kevin: ack. starting checks.
kevin: kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=prometheus-exporter -o wide
kevin: Some exporter pods show CrashLoopBackOff and others have steady 503s in the proxy logs. suspect upstream log-forwarder saturating.
kevin: curl http://metrics-exporter.eu-west-1.svc.cluster.local:9100/metrics
kevin: timeout after 10s. hitting exporter container directly returns 502 from sidecar. showing repeated `connection reset by peer` in sidecar logs.
ops-bot: Noted increased egress to logging backend from eu-west-1; average p95 throughput for forwarder has doubled in last 10m.
jordan: looks like log-forwarder backlog is building and sidecars are dropping connections to exporters. that explains missing scrape metrics.
maya: Customer impact: dashboards will be missing pod-level metrics and alerting might be suppressed for the eu-west cluster. ETA for next 30m unknown.
kevin: Initial mitigation plan:
1) throttle log-forwarder ingestion rate for eu-west to reduce backpressure
2) restart exporter sidecars in a staggered manner (avoid full scrape blackout)
3) temporarily increase prometheus scrape_timeout to 15s and scrape_interval to 30s for eu-west targets
4) open a reprocessing job for missed logs if necessary

kevin: Applying throttle for forwarder:
```
# update forwarder config
kubectl -n infra set env ds/log-forwarder FORWARD_RATE_LIMIT=2000
```
kevin: Restarting sidecars 1/3 with `kubectl rollout restart ds/metrics-sidecar -n monitoring --selector=zone=eu-west-1 --record` (staggered 30s)
jordan: I'll patch prometheus scrape config on the running configmap and reload:
```
kubectl -n monitoring patch configmap prometheus-scrape --patch '{"data":{"eu-west-1.yml":"scrape_interval: 30s\nscrape_timeout: 15s"}}'
kubectl -n monitoring exec deploy/prometheus -- prometheus --reload
```
ops-bot: Throttle applied. Observed drop in outgoing throughput to logging backend within 60s.
kevin: Sidecar restarts in progress. 1/3 succeeded, 2/3 in progress. no mass 503 spikes yet.
maya: Escalating to infra L2 (product-ops looped in) — product teams flagged missing metrics for live experiments. product-ops: please notify SRE if customer SLOs at risk.
product-ops: notified. will coordinate customer comms if we see persistent missing metrics >30m.
kevin: Prometheus config reload done; scrape_timeout bumped. monitoring shows reduced scrape error rate to 0.3 in eu-west-1 after the throttle and restarts.
jordan: continuing to watch logs. starting a targeted replay for the 10m backlog for high-priority metrics (service/ingest,service/frontend)
kevin: Starting reprocess job (safe window):
```
kubectl -n batch create job replay-metrics-eu-west --image=internal/replay:stable -- /replay --since 00:10:00 --targets frontend,ingest
```
incident-bot: Update: autopage escalated to SEV2 due to cross-region ripple (some replicas in ap-southeast show increased latency). Added escalation to infra-l2.
maya: Noted ap-southeast effects — looks like replicated forwarder clusters bumped due to retry storms. working with infra to apply rate-limits there too.
kevin: Follow-up actions:
- monitor for 15m, if scrape_error_rate < 0.1 and exporter restarts stable -> resolve
- file a postmortem with root cause: log-forwarder retry/backpressure and missing connection backpressure controls on sidecar
- propose permanent fix: backpressure-aware sidecar, circuit-breaker for exporter, and dynamic throttle per region

jordan: For now marking incident as mitigation in place. kevin staying on to observe for 30m. I'll take notes for postmortem.
product-ops: I'll draft a short customer note if this exceeds 30m. no escalations from major customers yet.
kevin: Observability: dashboards restored for main product metrics. p95 scrape latency down to normal. continuing to monitor.
maya: Great work. when stable we'll ack resolve in PD and start timeline for RCA.
jordan: closing my loop here. thanks all. :thumbsup:
pagerduty: Incident INC123456 acknowledged by kevin — status: monitoring
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation in place; monitoring for 30m. will auto-close page if stable.
